summary: At the September 2024 RJC summit, Whatley declared, "We stand by Israel. We stand with the Jewish people," with no mention of Palestinians or the humanitarian situation in Gaza. In June 2024, he retweeted Israel's hostage-rescue post, adopting its framing of the war as "what Israel is fighting for" and condemning Hamas without acknowledging Palestinian civilian harm. Both statements offer an unqualified defense of Israel with no recognition of Palestinian suffering.
